EN: Deliver the invitation to Maximus
ZH: 把请柬送给马克西姆斯

EN: Deliver Mr. House's party invitation to Maximus.
ZH: 把豪斯先生的派对请柬送给马克西姆斯。

EN: Hello, and welcome to Wild Wanda's! The only casino in town where guns are freely allowed.
ZH: 你好，欢迎来到狂野万达！这座城里唯一允许自由带枪的赌场。

EN: Is there anything I can do for you?
ZH: 有什么能为您效劳的吗？

EN: Maximus, let's see… Yes, he's here. Hope you find him! Watch out for angry gamblers!
ZH: 马克西姆斯，我看看……是的，他在这儿。希望你找得到他！小心那些愤怒的赌徒！

EN: Oh, yes, I remember. He'll be in there somewhere, hopefully he hasn't been shot!
ZH: 哦，是的，我记得。他就在里面某处，希望他还没被枪崩了！

EN: Excellent. You look tough, so maybe you'll even live to tell the tale!
ZH: 好极了。你看起来挺强悍的，说不定你真能活着讲完这段故事！

EN: We've got an invitation for Maximus.
ZH: 我们有一张给马克西姆斯的邀请函。

EN: Seen anyone in a Brotherhood uniform?
ZH: 见过穿兄弟会制服的人吗？

EN: Just looking for a good time.
ZH: 就是想找点乐子。

EN: Are you feeling lucky? What number am I thinking of?
ZH: 你觉得自己运气好吗？我现在想的是哪个数字？

EN: Ahh, nope, better luck next time.
ZH: 啊，不，不对，下次好运吧。

EN: Eugh, what a gross number! Take what you deserve!
ZH: 噫，多恶心的数字！拿走你应得的东西吧！

EN: That's it! You got it!
ZH: 就是它！你猜对了！

EN: Five.
ZH: 五。

EN: One hundred and forty-four.
ZH: 一百四十四。

EN: Thirty-seven.
ZH: 三十七。

EN: For all the caps! Red or black?
ZH: 押上你所有的瓶盖！红还是黑？

EN: And it lands on…! RED! You won! Well done.
ZH: 落定的是……！红色！你赢了！干得漂亮。

EN: And it lands on…! RED! You lost! Too bad. Better luck next time.
ZH: 落定的是……！红色！你输了！太可惜了。下次好运吧。

EN: That's not… uh, well, it was red. Sorry!
ZH: 那不是……呃，好吧，是红色。抱歉！

EN: Red.
ZH: 红色。

EN: Black.
ZH: 黑色。

EN: White.
ZH: 白色。

EN: Sudden death Blackjack! Hit or stay?
ZH: 猝死制二十一点！要牌还是停牌？

EN: BUST! Now you die!
ZH: 爆牌！受死吧！

EN: DEALER WINS! Now you die!
ZH: 庄家通吃！受死吧！

EN: The only way to win is not to play… well done!
ZH: 唯一赢的办法就是不玩……干得漂亮！

EN: Hit.
ZH: 要牌。

EN: Stay.
ZH: 停牌。

EN: Fold.
ZH: 弃牌。

EN: H-hello. I'm Brother Maximus. I was just, uh, inspecting this place. For… tech.
ZH: 你……你好。我是马克西姆斯兄弟。我刚才只是在，呃，视察这地方。为了……寻找科技。

EN: Oh. Phew! Cool. Yeah, I like parties. I'll uh, see you there.
ZH: 哦。呼！太好了。行吧，我喜欢派对。那，呃，到时见。

EN: Invitation? For… for me? Is it a trap? No, vault people wouldn't do that. Okay. I'll be there.
ZH: 邀请函？给……给我的？是陷阱吗？不，避难所居民不会那么干。好吧。我会去的。

EN: Mr. House? Who's… uh, I mean, of course. Why wouldn't he want to meet me? I'm important! And talented!
ZH: 豪斯先生？他是……呃，我是说，当然。他怎么会不想见我？我可是大人物！而且才华横溢！

EN: None of my beeswax! Come to Mr. House's party!
ZH: 关我屁事！快来参加豪斯先生的派对吧！

EN: We have this invitation to Maximus for Mr. House's surprise party.
ZH: 我们有一张给马克西姆斯的邀请函，是豪斯先生的惊喜派对。

EN: Mr. House is itching to make your acquaintance.
ZH: 豪斯先生正热切地期盼与你相识。

EN: Observe our high-quality gatling lasers!
ZH: 见识见识我们优质的加特林激光枪！

EN: On wheels, we can outrun any thief or assailant!
ZH: 靠着轮子，我们能甩掉任何窃贼或袭击者！

EN: We are guaranteed not to attack invited guests. Unless they start attacking, like this!
ZH: 我们保证不攻击受邀宾客。除非他们先动手，就像这样！

EN: We can be programmed to be congenial and talkative!
ZH: 我们可以被编程得亲切又健谈！

EN: Securitrons are supposed to be excellent guards. Go see Victor at RobCo headquarters and discuss security for Mr. House's party.
ZH: 保安机器人本该是出色的守卫。去 罗伯科 总部见维克托，讨论豪斯先生派对的安保事宜。

EN: Shiny Security
ZH: 闪亮的安保

EN: Test Securitron weapons
ZH: 测试保安机器人的武器

EN: Test Securitron mobility
ZH: 测试保安机器人的机动性

EN: Approve Securitron security with Victor
ZH: 与维克托确认保安机器人的安保方案

EN: Organize security for Mr. House's party.
ZH: 为豪斯先生的派对安排安保。

EN: Howdy, stranger! What a delightful surprise, runnin' into you.
ZH: 你好啊，陌生人！在这儿碰到你可真是惊喜。

EN: I'm just here checkin' in on my friends. What brings you here?
ZH: 我只是来看看我的朋友。你们来这儿做什么？

EN: Well, shucks! Of course we can! Please take the time to peruse and test out our Securitrons.
ZH: 哎呀，小意思！当然可以！请随便参观、测试我们的保安机器人。

EN: You're in the right place, friend. Take a tour of our fully-automated defense demonstrations!
ZH: 你来对地方了，朋友。去参观一下我们全自动的防御演示吧！

EN: Well, ain't that sweet. Say no more, friend. We'll help keep it secret, and keep it safe.
ZH: 哎呀，真贴心。啥也别说了，朋友。我们会帮你们保密，也会保证它的安全。

EN: Can you handle security for Mr. House's party?
ZH: 你们能负责豪斯先生派对的安保吗？

EN: We're just here to test out the Securitrons.
ZH: 我们就是来测试保安机器人的。

EN: We're having a secret party for Mr. House. Don't tell anyone!
ZH: 我们要为豪斯先生办一场秘密派对。别告诉任何人！

EN: We can be programmed to be congenial and talkative! Please test out our conversation skills.
ZH: 我们可以被编程得亲切又健谈！请测试一下我们的对话技巧。

EN: Yes, the sun is in the sky and there is temperature.
ZH: 是的，太阳在天上，而且有温度。

EN: Logic loop detected. Rebooting system. Combat systems initiated.
ZH: 检测到逻辑循环。正在重启系统。战斗系统已启动。

EN: Aggression will be met with lethal force.
ZH: 攻击行为将遭到致命还击。

EN: Nice weather today.
ZH: 今天天气不错。

EN: This sentence is a lie.
ZH: 这句话是假的。

EN: I'll test out your aggression response. Put 'em up!
ZH: 我来测试一下你们的攻击反应。举起手来！

EN: You made it through! That's swell! What did you think?
ZH: 你闯过来了！真棒！你觉得怎么样？

EN: How else could ya tell they were good enough? I knew you could do it!
ZH: 不然你怎么知道它们够不够格呢？我就知道你能行！

EN: Yeehaw! That's the spirit!
ZH: 耶哈！就是这样！

EN: I can be any Securitron I like. And you can bet your bottom dollar I'll be at the party!
ZH: 我想当什么保安机器人就当什么。而且你尽管放心，我会去参加派对的！

EN: Was all the shooting necessary?
ZH: 刚才有必要开那么多枪吗？

EN: They're perfect. See you at the party.
ZH: 它们完美极了。派对见。

EN: Aren't you downstairs right now?
ZH: 你现在不正在楼下吗？

EN: WELCOOOOME!
TRY THE WINE!
ZH: 来尝尝这酒！

EN: GRRRREAT PARTY!
ZH: 超——棒的派对！

EN: They say there's a big Ghoul party happening nearby. Could be a good place to scout staff for Mr. House's party.
ZH: 据说附近有一场大型尸鬼派对。说不定是个物色豪斯先生派对工作人员的好地方。

EN: Party Poaching
ZH: 派对挖角

EN: Find kitchen staff
ZH: 寻找厨房工作人员

EN: Find a comedian
ZH: 找一位喜剧演员

EN: Find musicians
ZH: 找乐手

EN: Find folks to staff Mr. House's party.
ZH: 为豪斯先生的派对物色工作人员。

EN: Are we sure this is the right place? Not a great atmosphere for a party.
ZH: 我们确定这是对的地方吗？这派对氛围可不太好。

EN: Anyone willing to cater to Ghouls would make the perfect staff for our shindig.
ZH: 愿意为尸鬼做餐饮的人，正是为我们狂欢派对的完美人选。

EN: Unless it's a Ghoul party. Then, it's the perfect atmosphere!
ZH: 除非这是尸鬼派对。那就完美了！

EN: This Ghoul party is falling apart. Just like the hosts!
ZH: 这场尸鬼派对要完蛋了。就跟主办人一样！

EN: Seriously. All the Ghouls started going feral after the party started. Real scary stuff.
ZH: 说真的。派对开始后，所有尸鬼都开始发狂了。真吓人。

EN: Honey, the audience could be literally dead and I would be happier than I am here.
ZH: 亲爱的，就算观众全死光了，我也比在这儿高兴。

EN: Yeesh. If he needs a comedian, he's got worse problems than me! I'll take the gig!
ZH: 天哪。他要真需要喜剧演员，那他自己的问题比我还大！这活儿我接了！

EN: To kill someone with laughter… truly a comedian's highest praise!
ZH: 让人笑得没命……这才是喜剧演员的最高赞誉！

EN: Funny. Want to tell jokes at our party?
ZH: 有意思。想在咱们派对上讲笑话吗？

EN: We need a comedian for Mr. House's party.
ZH: 我们需要一位喜剧演员来给豪斯先生的派对助兴。

EN: You'll make a killing at Mr. House's party.
ZH: 你在豪斯先生的派对上会大出风头的。

EN: What's the deal? No one's eating the food! Everyone's just eating each other!
ZH: 怎么回事？没人吃那些食物！大家都在互相吃！

EN: We don't care either way. A job's a job. See you there!
ZH: 我们怎么都行。活就是活。到时见！

EN: My skilled hands are busy! But they'll be free for your party.
ZH: 我这双手可忙着呢！不过到你们派对时就能腾出来了。

EN: I knew I was better than just a home chef. Now I hit the big time!
ZH: 我就知道我比一个家庭厨师强。现在我可要大展身手了！

EN: Our party will have zero Feral Ghouls. Promise.
ZH: 我们的派对保证绝对没有狂尸鬼。我保证。

EN: We need your skilled hands for Mr. House's party.
ZH: 我们需要你这双巧手来操办豪斯先生的派对。

EN: This is hell's kitchen. Come work for me.
ZH: 这是地狱厨房。来给我干活吧。

EN: Okay, gang, pick it up! We have sapient partygoers! One… two… one, two, three, four!
ZH: 好了，伙计们，打起精神！我们有清醒的宾客！一……二……一、二、三、四！

EN: Mr. House? Oof, that sounds like a whole different kind of dangerous. But yeah, sure.
ZH: 豪斯先生？哦，那可完全是另一种危险。不过，行吧，当然。

EN: Uh, sure. We're still on the clock for two more hours, though. You should get out, it's dangerous in here.
ZH: 呃，好啊。不过我们还有两个小时才下班呢。你们该出去，这里很危险。

EN: I've heard enough. You're hired for Mr. House's party!
ZH: 我听得够多了。你被豪斯先生的派对录用了！

EN: Want to play at a party that isn't in a graveyard?
ZH: 想在一个不在墓地里的派对上演奏吗？

EN: It's a Ghoul party, alright… but why are they attacking us? Are they feral?
ZH: 这确实是场尸鬼派对，没错……但他们为什么要攻击我们？他们狂暴化了吗？

EN: Weird move to invite feral Ghouls to a party.
ZH: 把狂尸鬼请到派对上来，这举动可真够奇怪的。

EN: Woah. That's like slasher movie material!
ZH: 哇。这简直是恐怖片素材！

EN: Let's hope not since we want to hire their kitchen staff.
ZH: 但愿不是，因为我们还想雇他们的厨房工作人员呢。

EN: Maybe they turned feral at the party.
ZH: 也许他们是到派对现场才发狂的。

EN: Maybe they're angry because the dip was off.
ZH: 也许他们是因为蘸酱不对而生气。

EN: The time has come for Mr. House's party! But… what's that sound? Radroaches! Squish them all before the rest of the guests arrive!
ZH: 豪斯先生派对的时刻到了！可……那是什么声音？辐射蟑螂！在其余宾客到达之前，把它们统统踩扁！

EN: Squishing the Party
ZH: 踩扁派对的虫子

EN: Ask for roach squishing music
ZH: 索要踩虫音乐

EN: Confer with the wait staff
ZH: 与服务员商议

EN: Check in with Mr. House
ZH: 向豪斯先生报告

EN: Squish the Radroaches that have crashed Mr. House's party.
ZH: 踩扁那些闯进豪斯先生派对的辐射蟑螂。

EN: <Radroach noises>
ZH: <辐射蟑螂的声响>

EN: Radroaches? At our party!? The party organizer's job is never done.
ZH: 辐射蟑螂？在我们派对上！？派对策划人的活儿可真是没完没了。

EN: By now I'm used to the guests trying to eat me.
ZH: 如今我早已习惯宾客们想把我吃掉的事了。

EN: Who invited the roaches? I bet it was the chef. Maybe they're really ingredients.
ZH: 谁请的蟑螂？我打赌是厨师。也许它们真的是食材。

EN: It never hurt to be a smartass in my business. So far. Everyone who's shot has missed.
ZH: 在我的行当里，耍点小聪明从不吃亏。至少目前如此。朝我开过枪的人全都打偏了。

EN: Ooh, that's rich. Maybe the roaches will be a bit more grateful.
ZH: 噢，那可真够逗的。也许蟑螂会领情一些。

EN: Look, don't get smart. We're dealing with it.
ZH: 听好了，别耍嘴皮子。我们会处理的。

EN: If you want to help, tell them some of your jokes.
ZH: 如果你想帮忙，就给它们讲几个你的笑话吧。

EN: What kind of music should we play for this bug-squashing portion of the party?
ZH: 派对踩虫子这段，我们该放点什么音乐？

EN: Yes, to get the blood pumping! Go get them, boss!
ZH: 好，让血液沸腾起来！去收拾它们吧，老大！

EN: Ah, the poor roaches. They can't help the way they are.
ZH: 啊，可怜的蟑螂。它们也没办法改变自己的本性。

EN: Ignore the vermin and honor the man of the hour. I like it!
ZH: 无视这些小害虫，致敬今晚的主角。我喜欢！

EN: Something fast and exciting.
ZH: 来点快节奏又刺激的。

EN: Something mournful.
ZH: 来点哀伤的。

EN: Something grandiose.
ZH: 来点宏大的。

EN: Hey, uh… Radroach meat is great and all, but… did you see any caviar?
ZH: 嘿，呃……辐射蟑螂肉固然不错，但是……你们看到鱼子酱了吗？

EN: Ah. Right, well. Not the same appeal, you know? I'll look around.
ZH: 啊。好吧，那。可不是一回事，对吧？我再找找。

EN: Oh! Sure, yeah. I can do that. Sorry.
ZH: 哦！行，好。我这就去。抱歉。

EN: Best I can offer is Radroach eggs.
ZH: 我最多只能给你辐射蟑螂蛋。

EN: Quit looking sorry for yourself and squash some bugs.
ZH: 别在那儿自怨自艾了，快去踩死几只虫子。

EN: The roaches are eating the hors-d'oeuvres! What should we do?
ZH: 那些蟑螂在吃开胃小菜！我们该怎么办？

EN: Oh. Are you sure? I mean, we can, but what will Mr. House think?
ZH: 哦。你确定吗？我是说，我们可以，但豪斯先生会怎么想？

EN: Yeah… but they're not even savoring them! What a waste.
ZH: 是啊……可它们连尝都不好好尝！真是浪费。

EN: Okay, I'll be back!
ZH: 好，我马上回来！

EN: Make new ones. Out of Radroach meat.
ZH: 重新做。用辐射蟑螂肉做。

EN: Forget it. As long as we still have a spread.
ZH: 算了。只要我们还摆得出酒菜就行。

EN: Run for supplies. We'll take care of things here.
ZH: 跑去找补给。这里交给我们。

EN: Howdy, pardner! This is quite a fine showdown!
ZH: 你好啊，老伙计！这可真是一场不错的对决！

EN: I'm mighty sorry the Securitrons aren't killin' these vermin. Unless they go after Mr. House o' course.
ZH: 很抱歉保安机器人没能干掉这些害虫。除非它们去找豪斯先生的麻烦，那当然例外。

EN: Allow me to offer some compensation for your troubles.
ZH: 请允许我为你们的辛苦略表补偿。

EN: I sure am sorry, pardner. At least there's no Deathclaws crashin' the party!
ZH: 我真的很抱歉，伙计。至少没有死爪来砸场子！

EN: This oughta set you up nice in that vault o' yours!
ZH: 这下够你在避难所里舒坦一阵了！

EN: Well, how's this to wet your lips?
ZH: 喏，这个怎么样，润润嗓子？

EN: Keep it. Just go squish some bugs.
ZH: 留着吧。去踩几只虫子就好。

EN: Sure, give it here.
ZH: 行，拿来吧。

EN: Actually, all this squishing made me thirsty.
ZH: 其实，踩了这么多虫子，我有点渴了。

EN: What a fabulous party. Reminds me of the shining old days, when Vegas was known the whole world over.
ZH: 多棒的派对啊。让我想起那段辉煌的旧时光，那时维加斯之名响彻全世界。

EN: I want to reward you for your diligent care and attention. What is your desire?
ZH: 我想为你们尽心尽责的照料与关注，给你们一些奖赏。你们想要什么？

EN: A pragmatic choice. Bottle caps make the Wasteland go 'round!
ZH: 务实的选择。瓶盖让废土转动！

EN: Wear it, and take the glory of New Vegas with you anywhere you go.
ZH: 穿上它，让新维加斯的荣光随你同行。

EN: Hold in your arms the power of the god of destruction.
ZH: 握紧毁灭之神的力量。

EN: Cash, please, Mr. House, sir.
ZH: 钱就好，豪斯先生。

EN: A nice outfit, perhaps?
ZH: 来身漂亮衣服，也许？

EN: I need some firepower.
ZH: 我需要点火力。

EN: Greetings, partygoer. Initiating small talk protocol.
ZH: 你好，派对来宾。启动闲聊协议。

EN: Would you please confirm or deny the presence of favorable weather?
ZH: 能否请您确认或否认存在宜人天气？

EN: Sass detected. Ending conversation. Move along.
ZH: 检测到顶嘴。结束对话。请继续前行。

EN: Cannot comply. Radroaches are not attacking Mr. House.
ZH: 无法照办。辐射蟑螂未在攻击豪斯先生。

EN: Weather's fine, no thanks to you.
ZH: 天气不错，可不是托你的福。

EN: Why aren't you helping deal with the Radroaches?
ZH: 你为什么不帮忙对付那些辐射蟑螂？

EN: House Warming
ZH: 乔迁派对

EN: Rackie Jobinson's Jersey continues to elude us!
ZH: 仍然没有罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫的踪影！

EN: Okay, so Holy Heart Hospital was a dead end. But at least we're still alive! Next stop, the ruins of Lakeville Library.
ZH: 好吧。所以圣心脏医院肯定是条死路了，但至少我们都还活着！下一站，莱克维尔图书馆。

EN: How Can You Not Be Romantic About Baseball?
ZH: 你怎么可能不喜欢棒球呢？

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Track Coach down in the Lakeville Library.
ZH: 去莱克维尔图书馆找教练。

EN: They make camp at a Radaway plant up north.
ZH: 他们在北部的消辐宁工厂扎营。

EN: Your boy came in with a shipment of other Dwellers and some Feral Ghouls.
ZH: 你们要找的人和一些其他的居民还有狂尸鬼一起被送过来的。

EN: But he disappeared when Khan Killian's Raider gang attacked!
ZH: 但是遭到可汗·基利安的掠夺者帮派袭击之后他就消失了！

EN: They outnumbered us 10 to 1... They took everything.
ZH: 他们的人数是我们的十倍……他们拿走了所有东西。

EN: If he's anywhere, he's with them.
ZH: 如果他可能在任何地方的话，他应该是和他们在一起。

EN: Where are they?
ZH: 他们在哪儿？

EN: Jack's been through the ringer - and now he might get turned into dinner! Slavers sold him to a Potted Meat plant. We need to head there!
